title: How does Pinnacle Blooms manage self-injurious behavior in children with Autism?
metaTitle: Managing Self-Injurious Behaviors in Autistic Children at Pinnacle Blooms Network
description: Discover how Pinnacle Blooms uses evidence-based ABA therapy techniques to manage and reduce self-injurious behaviors in children with autism.
html: At Pinnacle Blooms, we employ a compassionate and methodical approach to managing self-injurious behaviors in children with autism. Using Applied Behaviour Analysis (ABA) therapy, our professionals identify the causes triggering such behaviors. We then work on minimizing these instances and teach more acceptable alternative behaviors. We also incorporate self-soothing techniques helping children cope better under stress. As each child is unique, the strategies deployed are personalized in accordance with their needs.
